name: delivery-01
title: Delivery 01 - A Thing In Transit Over A Stage Rail
description: A thing moving through stages: what it is, where it stands, which stage it has reached, and an expected reading, over a rail composed from the steps Component. The words travel as strings because this Block is a server Component and the progress bar is a client one, and a function cannot cross that seam. A stage that has not happened carries a name, a date and nothing else, because a screen that shows a delivery time as though it had happened is lying to a reader who is waiting.
